headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a thrilling 4-6 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob Waguespack earning the win and Kenley Jansen securing the save. The Miami Marlins shut down the Pittsburgh Pirates in a 2-0 rout, led by Esteury Ruiz's home run and RBI, while Eury Pérez pitched 7 strong innings with 7 strikeouts. The Chicago Cubs took down the Washington Nationals 8-6, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense and Jacob Webb earning the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Los Angeles Dodgers' Blake Treinen has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The New York Yankees' Kervin Castro has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right elbow neuritis. The Miami Marlins' Kyle Stowers has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the acquisition of 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics have traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies have traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 2-0. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Eury Pérez pitched 7 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Mariners 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Treinen Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.
